label: 💥 Hydrogen + Oxygen
blurb: Two invisible gases ignite into a brilliant flash and pure water. The reaction that powered the Space Shuttle.
safety_callout: Hydrogen-oxygen mixtures detonate over a wide range of ratios. Lab demo only.

label: ✨ Magnesium Flash
blurb: A strip of dull grey metal ignites with a blinding white flame — the same trick used in old camera flashbulbs and modern flares.
safety_callout: Burns at ~3100 °C; the light can damage eyes. Never look directly at burning magnesium.

label: 🧂 Sodium + Chlorine → Salt
blurb: A reactive metal meets a poisonous yellow-green gas and they violently combine into harmless table salt. Pure chemistry magic.
safety_callout: Pure chlorine gas is lethal; sodium ignites on contact with water. The product (NaCl) is the salt on your fries.

label: 🌋 Thermite
blurb: Aluminum powder rips oxygen away from rust, releasing so much heat the iron melts and pours out white-hot.
safety_callout: Reaches ~2500 °C and cannot be extinguished by water. Industrial / demo use only.

label: 🥤 Hydrogen Peroxide Geyser
blurb: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide rips apart in seconds, blasting a tower of foam and steam — the kid-friendly 'elephant toothpaste' experiment.
safety_callout: Concentrated H2O2 burns skin and clothing. School demos use lower-concentration peroxide with dish soap for foam.

label: 🌈 Acid meets Base
blurb: A strong acid and a strong base cancel each other out, releasing heat. Add an indicator and it flips from pink to clear in an instant.
safety_callout: Both starting materials are highly caustic; product is salty water. Always add acid to water, not the reverse.

label: 🪨 Limestone Fizz
blurb: Drip strong acid onto limestone and the rock literally dissolves in a hissing cloud of CO2 — same reaction that carves caves.
safety_callout: HCl is corrosive. CO2 evolution can pressurize a sealed container.

label: 🔥 Methane Combustion
blurb: The blue flame on a gas stove: methane plus oxygen burns to invisible CO2 and water vapor, with most of the energy carried away as heat.
safety_callout: Incomplete combustion produces carbon monoxide. Always ensure good ventilation when burning methane.

label: 🍷 Ethanol Burn
blurb: Pour rubbing alcohol onto a dish, light it, and watch a pale ghostly flame dance across the surface — clean combustion to CO2 and water.
safety_callout: Ethanol vapors are flammable. The blue flame is nearly invisible in daylight — a common burn hazard.

label: 🌱 Photosynthesis
blurb: Plants pull CO2 and water out of thin air and assemble them into sugar, powered entirely by sunlight. The reaction that built the biosphere.
safety_callout: Endothermic — needs continuous light energy input. Without sunlight nothing happens.
